tests.description: Backup documentation is referenced and present on pages 3–9.
Payment method is not specified; credit card documentation is missing.
DR-14 certificate is referenced within the supporting pages (3–9).

justification: Exemption denied due to missing payment method documentation. DR-14 certificate is present, but payment method documentation is required under Rule 12A-1.061, F.A.C. and Section 125.0104, Florida Statutes.

tests.description: Backup documentation is referenced and present on pages 11–20.
Payment method is not specified; credit card documentation is missing.
DR-14 certificate is not referenced or found within the supporting pages (11–20).

justification: Exemption denied due to missing payment method documentation and lack of DR-14 certificate. Does not meet requirements of Rule 12A-1.061, F.A.C. and Section 125.0104, Florida Statutes.
